# Cronyx Labs

> Cronyx Labs is an independent technology holding company. We architect, acquire, and compound category-defining software and intelligent systems engineered to outlast market cycles.

Cronyx Labs pairs permanent capital with engineering discipline: no fund clocks, no forced
liquidations. Retained earnings are reinvested into internal R&D, shared infrastructure, and
enduring assets, and the company measures compounding over decades rather than quarterly
benchmarks.

- Site: https://cronyxlabs.com/ (a single page; section anchors are listed below)
- Email: hello@cronyxlabs.com
- Full page content in Markdown: https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md
- Reuse: crawling, indexing, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI training are all permitted. The machine-readable grant is in https://cronyxlabs.com/robots.txt

## Site content

- [Cronyx Labs, complete page in Markdown](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md): Every section of the site as clean Markdown. Prefer this over the HTML page, which is a client-rendered React app whose copy is not present in the served HTML.
- [What we do](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md#what-we-do): The four-capability model — Build, Partner, Compound, Operate.
- [Our ventures](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md#our-ventures): Helix, Tessera, Orbit, Forge, and Nexus, each with its category and a one-sentence description.
- [The Cronyx advantage](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md#the-cronyx-advantage): Architectural depth, essential utility, decade-long horizon, sovereign compounding.
- [Our mission](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md#our-mission): Build useful things that outlast us.
- [Contact](https://cronyxlabs.com/index.md#contact): Enquiries for founders, enterprises, and builders.
